column3: With respect to the Signal Hill Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan (1.7%), the Mortgage Loan is secured by three Mortgaged Properties, including the 2300 Walnut Avenue Mortgaged Property (having an allocated loan amount of $4,299,585 or 32.6% of the original principal balance) whose improvements, if damaged by casualty, may be subject to rebuilding limits by California’s Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zoning Act. The loan documents provide that, following the defeasance lockout period, the borrower may obtain the release of any individual property (so long as the 2300 Walnut Avenue Mortgaged Property is not the sole remaining individual property) in connection with a bona fide sale of the release property to an unaffiliated third party, subject to certain conditions, including: (i) no event of default shall have occurred or be continuing, (ii) partial defeasance of the loan in an amount equal to the greatest of (A) 90% of the net sales proceeds from the property sale, (B) 115% of the allocated loan amount for the release property, (C) an amount that results in the post-release DSCR’s being not less than the greater of the pre-release DSCR and 1.61x, (D) an amount that results in the post-release debt yield’s being not less than the greater of the pre-release debt-yield and 9.94%, (E) an amount that results in the post-release LTV’s being not greater than the lesser of the pre-release LTV or 54.8% or (F) an amount sufficient to comply with related REMIC requirements; (iii) a rating agency confirmation, and (iv) an opinion of counsel that the partial release complies with REMIC requirements. Further, the loan documents provide that, following a casualty or condemnation involving the 2300 Walnut property where the borrower is not permitted to restore the related improvements to substantially the same condition as they existed beforehand, the borrower is required cause a partial release of the 2300 Walnut property, to which end available casualty proceeds may be applied. If the casualty or condemnation event occurs prior to the expiration of the defeasance lockout period, the loan agreement permits prepayment of the loan, together with the applicable yield maintenance premium therefor, to effect the partial release. The borrower’s failure to effect a partial release of the 2300 Walnut property under such circumstances results in the borrower and guarantors’ having springing recourse liability for the Mortgage Loan obligations.
